title: AMP Registry Record
description: One entry in the AMP registry. Trust status lives here, outside the publisher's manifest, because a field a publisher sets about itself proves nothing. See section 19.4 of the specification.

legacy_id.description: Identifier this listing had in the original Postgres registry, so /listings/<legacy_id> keeps resolving

status.description: verified: the domain serves a valid manifest today. unverified: generated by AMP from public documentation; the publisher has never served a manifest. lapsed: the domain served a valid manifest before, but the current one has failed two consecutive checks.

submitted_via.description: The door this record came through. Records with 'migration' are exempt from deduplication and per-publisher caps.

url.description: The URL as it was submitted (the 'url' field of the public API)

domain.description: Host that serves (or, for unverified records, documents) the API

group.description: Publisher grouping used for directory layout and per-publisher caps: a contact GitHub org, an email domain, or the API's registrable domain

contact.description: Contact as declared in the manifest

source.description: Where the manifest content came from

representative_queries.description: Two to five natural-language questions this API answers (the ARD representativeQueries hint)

badges.description: Recomputed from fresh evidence on every verification run, never carried over

verified_at.description: When the record first became verified

consecutive_failures.description: Checks in a row that failed. A verified record becomes lapsed at 2.

snapshot.description: The manifest exactly as it passed. Present on lapsed records; on verified records the manifest field is the valid document.

last_valid.description: The most recent version that passed validation

current_errors.description: Error-severity failures from the latest check

manifest.description: Verified: the manifest the domain serves today. Lapsed: the most recently fetched manifest (null if unreachable). Unverified: the manifest AMP generated.
